file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/clhca.c" actual_sha)
if(NOT actual_sha STREQUAL "d31762a47e4003923f078b8ed7b25f191bfa82f8e6b212ddb9b77e0a19114aff")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned clHCA clhca.c digest mismatch")
endif()
file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/clhca.h" actual_sha)
if(NOT actual_sha STREQUAL "083ee638ed41ecb295423cede35c24a2de3659c35b6f6ea5554d7c2ab96af359")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned clHCA clhca.h digest mismatch")
endif()
file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/clhca_data.h" actual_sha)
if(NOT actual_sha STREQUAL "bad3edd920331b506e2d141e115c3638d3ab118b4af1752fcec96e9bd64d542c")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned clHCA clhca_data.h digest mismatch")
endif()
enable_language(C)
add_library(player2_hca_codec STATIC clhca.c)
target_include_directories(player2_hca_codec SYSTEM PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_compile_features(player2_hca_codec PRIVATE c_std_99)
target_compile_options(player2_hca_codec PRIVATE -fno-strict-aliasing)
set_target_properties(player2_hca_codec PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
